Name: Vote To Buy
Author: Kibling
Description: Allows other players to approve/decline a players purchase if the amount goes over the maximum limit. At least 50% of players must approve for the purchase to go through. If the purchase is declined the player who made the purchase must wait 15 seconds before they can do the purchase again. The mod also supports the Generic Mod Config Menu. If you have that then the host can set the maximum amount to any value. You can disable the mod if you set the value to -1. [b][size=3]Everyone must have the mod for it to work properly.[/size][/b]

Manifest.Name: Validate Purchases
Manifest.Description: Players can now decide on purchases other players make.
